projects.name: SprintStart
projects.blurb: An AI-assisted onboarding platform: connect a GitHub org, ingest every PR, issue, file and uploaded document, and make it all searchable, citable and summarizable — with an onboarding buddy on top.

projects.name: SoPra Office Dashboard
projects.blurb: A 4K kiosk cycling through calendar, parking, lunch, weather and FallingCats views, with an admin area behind it.

projects.name: BSEM Annotation Audit
projects.blurb: 216 tweets, two annotators, one codebook: what discussion does to agreement (Bennett's S, κ, AC1) — plus a 76-criterion audit of COCO vs SA-1B.

projects.name: PE2 Todo App
projects.blurb: Todo app with Kanban board, statistics dashboard and assignee management — plus an ML priority classifier as the highlight.

projects.name: PE2 Library CLI
projects.blurb: German command-line library manager: loans & returns with late fees, ISBN reservation queues, quoted-field CSV round-trip — refactored from a single 985-line file into five layers.

projects.name: PE1 Selection Wheel
projects.blurb: A spinning-wheel selector whose deceleration physics is pure, testable math — and whose renderer can paint exact captures headlessly.

projects.name: EInf Student Organizer
projects.blurb: Modules with ECTS and status, deadline cards, an ECTS-weighted GPA and a grade simulator.

projects.name: Computergrafik
projects.blurb: Nine sheets from first pixel to shaded scene: a CPU raytracer verified against the course reference, OpenGL image viewers, geometry and GLTF scenes.
